title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Show recently searched in Tell Me
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 adds recently searched items to the Tell Me search feature (Alt+Q), allowing users to quickly access their three most recent searches without entering search terms. This speeds up finding pages, reports, and documentation.
key_points: Tell Me now displays the three most recent searches in a Recents section when no search terms are entered
The feature works in both regular Tell Me and Advanced Tell Me search
Recent searches persist across browser sessions but are cleared in incognito or private browsing modes after logout
Users can still search for pages, reports, data, and Business Central documentation as before

quotes.text: Find pages and reports faster by accessing recent searches in Tell Me (Alt+Q).
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core benefit of the feature for improved user productivity

quotes.text: When you don't enter any search terms, the Recents section displays your three most recent searches.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies exactly how and when the feature appears to users
